turnout.notes: New Hampshire turnout rows now use official Secretary of State town/ward ballots-cast and names-on-checklist workbooks normalized into the NH town/ward CSV. Detailed ballots-cast rows sum to 831,468, one above the workbook county summary total after the source correction note.

reviewCharts.directionalScreenReason: U.S. House district workbooks provide same town/ward-grain Democratic and Republican comparison rows for all loaded New Hampshire President rows. The comparison is cleaner than Governor, but still district-based rather than a single statewide contest.
corroborationNeeded: historical New Hampshire President-versus-U.S. House and President-versus-Governor split-ticket baselines; official 2016 county presidential baseline artifacts are collected and normalized, but active NH historical import needs a shared native dispatcher change; 2020 and 2012 official sources remain blocked
town/ward boundary geometry or an official reporting-unit crosswalk

reviewCharts.warning: New Hampshire review rows are town/ward-level President-versus-U.S.-House comparisons from archived official Secretary of State workbooks. U.S. House is a same-grain comparison but district-based rather than a single statewide contest, so directional labels remain advisory screening context. State-native ballots-cast and names-on-checklist turnout rows are loaded from official workbooks; detailed ballots-cast rows sum one vote above the county summary after a source correction note. Town/ward boundary geometry is not included.

historicalBaselines.warning: New Hampshire historical baselines are county-level contextual rows normalized from archived official Secretary of State 2016 and 2020 President and presidential write-in workbooks. They are used for county flip context only; 2012 official sources remain request-blocked.
